column1: Though we might think of film as an essentially visual experience, we really cannot afford to underestimate the importance of film sound.
column2: 我们或许觉得电影本质上是视觉体验，但绝不能低估电影声音的重要性。

column1: A meaningful sound track is often as complicated as the image on the screen, and is ultimately just as much the responsibility of the director.
column2: 要让一条声带真正传达意义，往往和构成银幕画面一样复杂。归根到底，导演对声音负有同样的责任。

column1: The entire sound track consists of three essential ingredients: the human voice, sound effects and music.
column2: 完整的声带由三个基本要素构成：人声、音效和音乐。

column1: These three tracks must be mixed and balanced so as to produce the necessary emphases which in turn create desired effects.
column2: 这三条声轨必须经过混音和音量平衡处理，才能形成所需的重点，进而营造预期效果。

column1: Topics which essentially refer to the three previously mentioned tracks are discussed below.
column2: 下文将讨论与上述三条声轨密切相关的几个主题。

column1: They include dialogue, synchronous and asynchronous sound effects, and music.
column2: 这些主题包括对白、同步与非同步音效，以及音乐。

column1: Let us start with dialogue.
column2: 我们先从对白说起。

column1: As is the case with stage drama, dialogue serves to tell the story and expresses feelings and motivations of characters as well.
column2: 和舞台剧一样，电影对白既起到叙事作用，也表达人物的感情和动机。

column1: Often with film characterization the audience perceives little or no difference between the character and the actor.
column2: 电影塑造人物时，观众往往觉得角色和演员几乎没什么区别，甚至完全就是同一个人。
column3: film characterization|电影中的人物塑造
column6: little or no difference|几乎没有或完全没有差别

column1: Thus, for example, the actor Humphrey Bogart is the character Sam Spade; film personality and life personality seem to merge.
column2: 因此，以亨弗莱·鲍嘉为例，在观众眼里，这位演员就是他演的萨姆·斯佩德；银幕上的个性和现实中的个性似乎合二为一。

column1: Perhaps this is because the very texture of a performer’s voice supplies an element of character.
column2: 这也许是因为，演员嗓音本身的质地就是构成人物个性的一个要素。
column6: element of character|人物个性的一个要素

column1: When voice textures fit the performer’s physiognomy and gestures, a whole and very realistic persona emerges.
column2: 当音色与演员的容貌和姿态相契合时，一个完整而十分逼真的人物形象就浮现出来。

column1: The viewer sees not an actor working at his craft, but another human being struggling with life.
column2: 观众看到的是另一个为生活挣扎的人，已然忘记了眼前其实是一个演员在施展演技。
column4: working at his craft|施展其表演技艺
column6: struggling with life|为生活而挣扎

column1: It is interesting to note that how dialogue is used and the very amount of dialogue used varies widely among films.
column2: 值得留意的是，不同影片运用对白的方式和对白本身的多少，都差异极大。

column1: For example, in the highly successful science-fiction film 2001, little dialogue was evident, and most of it was banal and of little intrinsic interest.
column2: 例如，大获成功的科幻片《2001：太空漫游》里几乎没有对白，而仅有的那些大多平淡无奇，内容本身也没什么趣味。

column1: In this way the film-maker was able to portray what Thomas Sobochack and Vivian Sobochack call, in An Introduction to Film, the ‘inadequacy of human responses when compared with the magnificent technology created by man and the visual beauties of the universe’.
column2: 通过这种方式，导演成功表现了托马斯·索布查克和薇薇安·索布查克在《电影导论》中所说的情形：“与人类创造的宏伟科技及宇宙的视觉之美相比，人类的反应显得何其贫乏。”
column5: An Introduction to Film|《电影导论》

column1: The comedy Bringing Up Baby, on the other hand, presents practically non-stop dialogue delivered at breakneck speed.
column2: 喜剧片《育婴奇谭》则恰好相反，片中对白几乎没有间歇，语速还快得惊人。
column4: on the other hand|另一方面
column7: at breakneck speed|以惊人的速度

column1: This use of dialogue underscores not only the dizzy quality of the character played by Katherine Hepburn, but also the absurdity of the film itself and thus its humor.
column2: 这种对白既突出了凯瑟琳·赫本所饰人物冒失轻率的一面，也强调了影片本身的荒诞，从而烘托出喜剧效果。

column1: The audience is bounced from gag to gag and conversation to conversation; there is no time for audience reflection.
column2: 一个笑料接着一个笑料，一场对话接着一场对话，观众被带着一路往前，根本没有时间回味。
column3: bounced from gag to gag|被接连不断的笑料带着走

column1: The audience is caught up in a whirlwind of activity in simply managing to follow the plot.
column2: 观众光是要跟上情节，就已不由自主地卷入旋风般的行动之中。
column4: whirlwind of activity|旋风般的忙乱

column1: This film presents pure escapism - largely due to its frenetic dialogue.
column2: 这部影片营造出纯粹的遁世之乐，很大程度上正是靠它急促热烈的对白。
column3: pure escapism|全然脱离现实的消遣
column5: frenetic dialogue|急促而热烈的对白

column1: Synchronous sound effects are those sounds which are synchronized or matched with what is viewed.
column2: 所谓同步音效，就是声音与画面上看到的动作同步或相互匹配。
column6: what is viewed|画面上所见的事物

column1: For example, if the film portrays a character playing the piano, the sounds of the piano are projected.
column2: 比如，画面中若有人弹钢琴，放映时就会传出钢琴声。

column1: Synchronous sounds contribute to the realism of film and also help to create a particular atmosphere.
column2: 同步音效有助于增强影片的真实感，也有助于营造特定氛围。

column1: For example, the ‘click’ of a door being opened may simply serve to convince the audience that the image portrayed is real, and the audience may only subconsciously note the expected sound.
column2: 例如，开门时的“咔嗒”声可能只是要让观众相信画面中的情形是真实的，而观众可能只在潜意识中留意到这理应出现的声响。

column1: However, if the ‘click’ of an opening door is part of an ominous action such as a burglary, the sound mixer may call attention to the ‘click’ with an increase in volume; this helps to engage the audience in a moment of suspense.
column2: 不过，若开门的“咔嗒”声伴随着入室行窃之类的不祥举动，混音师可能会调高音量，让观众注意那声“咔嗒”，从而把观众引入充满悬念的时刻。
column6: call attention to|引起对……的注意
column8: engage the audience|吸引观众投入其中

column1: Asynchronous sound effects, on the other hand, are not matched with a visible source of the sound on screen.
column2: 非同步音效则不同，在银幕上看不到与声音相对应的声源。
column4: on the other hand|另一方面

column1: Such sounds are included so as to provide an appropriate emotional nuance, and they may also add to the realism of the film.
column2: 加入这些声音，是为了传达恰当而细微的情感色彩；它们也可能增强影片的真实感。

column1: For example, a film-maker might opt to include the background sound of an ambulance’s siren while the foreground sound and image portrays an arguing couple.
column2: 例如，导演可以选择把救护车的警笛声放在背景里，而前景中的声音与画面表现的则是一对正在争吵的夫妻。

column1: The asynchronous ambulance siren underscores the psychic injury incurred in the argument; at the same time the noise of the siren adds to the realism of the film by acknowledging the film’s city setting.
column2: 这个画外的救护车警笛声突出了争吵中造成的心理伤害。同时，警笛的响声点明故事以城市为背景，又增强了影片的真实感。

column1: We are probably all familiar with background music in films, which has become so ubiquitous as to be noticeable in its absence.
column2: 我们大概都熟悉电影配乐；它是如此无处不在，以至于往往要等到它消失，观众才会察觉。
column6: noticeable in its absence|缺席时反而引人注意

column1: We are aware that it is used to add emotion and rhythm.
column2: 我们知道，配乐可以给影片增添情感与节奏。

column1: Usually not meant to be noticeable, it often provides a tone or an emotional attitude toward the story and/or the characters depicted.
column2: 配乐通常无意引人注意，却常常为故事、片中人物或两者定下基调，或表明某种情感态度。
column6: characters depicted|影片所刻画的人物

column1: In addition, background music often foreshadows a change in mood.
column2: 此外，背景音乐往往会预示情绪的变化。

column1: For example, dissonant music may be used in film to indicate an approaching (but not yet visible) menace or disaster.
column2: 例如，电影可能用不协和的音乐预示一个正在逼近、却还看不见的威胁或灾难。

column1: Background music may aid viewer understanding by linking scenes.
column2: 背景音乐还可以将各个场景串联起来，帮助观众理解影片。

column1: For example, a particular musical theme associated with an individual character or situation may be repeated at various points in a film in order to remind the audience of salient motifs or ideas.
column2: 例如，与特定人物或情境相联系的音乐主题，可能在影片的不同节点反复出现，提醒观众留意突出的母题或观念。

column1: Film sound comprises conventions and innovations.
column2: 电影声音既有惯例，也有创新。

column1: We have come to expect an acceleration of music during car chases and creaky doors in horror films.
column2: 我们已习惯在追车戏中听见越来越快的音乐，在恐怖片中听见门吱呀作响。
column3: come to expect|逐渐习以为常

column1: Yet, it is important to note as well that sound is often brilliantly conceived.
column2: 不过，也别忘了，影片中的声音常常凝聚着极其巧妙的构思。

column1: The effects of sound are often largely subtle and often are noted by only our subconscious minds.
column2: 声音的作用往往相当微妙，很多时候只有潜意识才会察觉。
column3: effects of sound|声音产生的效果

column1: We need to foster an awareness of film sound as well as film space so as to truly appreciate an art form that sprang to life during the twentieth century — the modern film.
column2: 我们既需要培养对电影空间的感知，也需要培养对电影声音的感知，才能真正欣赏在20世纪焕发生机的这一艺术形式——现代电影。
